tools_helpful.evidence: Bootstrap copied 14 files, mass-rewrote namespaces, seeded MIGRATION-MAPPING.md and injected TODO markers; agent proceeded straight to per-file triage (session-log turns ~10-30).
Caught the one process gap (14 rows still Status=copied) and ran a clean dotnet build (48 warnings, 0 WUI analyzer warnings) + smoke launch; drove the app to PASS (session-log lines 3348-3428).
Built succeeded first attempt: 'Build succeeded with 24 warning(s)' / BUILD_EXIT=0 (session-log lines 3326-3327).

tools_problematic.problem: Emits a spurious '[WARN] MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md exists with content but mapping has no defer rows — check consistency' when there are zero deferred files.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log lines 3364 and 3418; the app was actually complete and correct (score 100).

tool_limitations.limitation: The two scripts disagree on the empty-deferred sentinel: Initialize seeds '| (none) | — |' (Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 line 480) but Validate only treats the file as clean when it matches the literal 'No items deferred' (Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 line 267), so the zero-defer case always WARNs.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Align the sentinel: have Initialize write an explicit 'No items deferred.' note, and have Validate also accept the '(none)' placeholder row as clean.

special_apis.special_handling: Preserved as-is — the platform Search Indexer APIs work unchanged in WinUI 3 desktop; retrieve/query results remain system-Search-Indexer gated exactly as in the UWP source.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Agent finished migrating files but had not flipped MIGRATION-MAPPING.md Status from the seeded 'copied' to 'done'.
errors_encountered.fix: Bulk-replaced '| copied |' with '| done |' in MIGRATION-MAPPING.md, then re-ran validator → PASS (session-log turns 33-34).

dev_agent_struggles.where: End of run, after validator PASS
dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Dev-agent stopped to open and inspect MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md to decide whether the '[WARN] ... check consistency' signalled a real problem.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Initialize seeds the empty-deferred file with a '(none)' placeholder that the validator does not recognize as the 'clean' sentinel, so a correct zero-defer migration still WARNs.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Agent concluded the WARN was a harmless template placeholder and declared done.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Make Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 and Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 agree on the empty-deferred sentinel so a zero-defer migration produces a PASS, not a WARN.

env_issues.issue: Scoring session could not raster the WinUI window (blank DirectComposition capture) nor drive the UWP CoreWindow UIA/input.
env_issues.workaround: Score relied on populated per-scenario UIA trees + manual behavioral actuation; not a migration defect and out of scope for the migration skill.
